bounded_host_request.command:
p=/home/admin1/server-core
v=0
git -C "$p" diff --quiet || v=$((v+1))
git -C "$p" diff --cached --quiet || v=$((v+2))
test -z "$(git -C "$p" ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" || v=$((v+4))
git -C "$p" diff --quiet -- operations/master-internal-repositories.json || v=$((v+8))
git -C "$p" symbolic-ref -q --short HEAD | grep -qx main || v=$((v+16))
git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD | grep -qx 6ab1b4dce10c684cfd3f7e15462a6c54fd05af58 || v=$((v+32))
exit "$v"
